_comment: Orgs deliberately kept off the map, by slug id. Without this, re-running an import would resurrect them, since dedupe only compares against rows currently in the target file. Each entry records why.
d-d-in-a-castle: Tabletop Vacations Inc., a for-profit company selling tabletop-gaming retreats in England and Ohio. Not a volunteering opportunity.
banc-of-california: A bank. Its own site lists no volunteer program; the row came in with the San Diego batch but there is nothing for a volunteer to sign up for.
live4legacy: Live4Legacy Brand, an online apparel storefront rather than a nonprofit. Not a volunteering opportunity.
capstone-federal-credit-union: A credit union. Not a volunteering opportunity.
home-saver-realty: A real-estate brokerage; its sheet note is about agent licensing, not volunteering.
euraupair-au-pair-agency: An au pair placement agency, not a volunteer organization.
mercer-advisors-newport-beach: A wealth-management firm whose community service is for its own staff only.
seaview-plaza: Run by Silver Tree Residential, a property-management company; no volunteer program.
timeshare-xchange: A timeshare business; its listed website is not an active nonprofit registry, and it shares a Costa Mesa address with Home Saver Realty.
western-turbine-users-inc: A trade group for gas-turbine industry professionals; its volunteers are its own members.
sacred-roots-alchemy: Tied to a healing center in Easthampton, Massachusetts; no Orange County volunteer program found.
sendsomeonetoday: Its website is a parked domain, and no organization by this name could be found.
make-a-change: Its website domain does not exist, and no organization by this name could be found at the listed Laguna Niguel address.
a-rainbow-away: Its only "website" was a paypal.me payment link, its address was in Northridge (LA), and no organization by this name could be found.
